name: Yamaha Kanata
source:
Member of the M3 Club. Loves music and handles composition.

Currently feeling the limits of his own talent and stuck in a creative rut.

He has a competitive, hardworking side, but is quite shy about showing it to others, so he often gets misunderstood.

Living with a girl his own age named Kuon means he ends up as the tsukkomi a lot.

He has a normal amount of interest in erotic things for his age, and Kuon has figured out various things about him.

He’s built up a tolerance for teasing and can just ignore it now.

He dreams of making everyone happy and bringing them joy through music.

“…Too many distractions. Maybe I should compose something to clear my head.”
